Scope: roads and paving, potable water, TSE, sewer, storm water, irrigation and landscaping, electrical (medium voltage, telecom, street lighting) and CCTV networks in Zones A and G, over 18 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. On 26-Oct-2026 the project is 46.4% complete against 42.2% planned, 4.3% ahead (SPI 1.10). This week it gained 0.99% against 1.49% planned, so the lead narrowed from 4.8% to 4.3%, the second weekly drop in a row. Road works and the storm and sewer networks are ahead; procurement, engineering, electrical works and CCTV are behind.

Ahead overall, but the lead is shrinking and procurement is still behind. This week's progress (0.99%) was again under the weekly plan (1.49%). Procurement is at 60.4% against 99.4% planned (SPI 0.61): MV cables (0 of 51,500 m), unit substations, street lighting poles and lighting panels are still not delivered, and the final substation location is still pending between the Client and SEC. The P6 update still finishes the project on the contract date, 05-Jul-2027, with zero float, but float on the MV and road-works milestones fell by 6 days this week.

The weekly report and the P6 update disagree on four milestone dates. Mobilisation finished on 05-Feb-2026 in the weekly report but on 06-Apr-2026 in P6. Technical submittals finished on 16-Aug-2026 in the weekly report but on 25-Jul-2026 in P6. The weekly report forecasts the engineering phase to finish on 28-Sep-2026, while P6 still has it open on 26-Oct-2026. Procurement finishes on 17-Jan-2027 in the weekly report and 29-Dec-2026 in P6. In this week's P6 update the MV works moved 9 days later, to 37 days after their baseline (float 21 days, from 27), and road works moved 7 days later, to 10 days after their baseline (float 12 days, from 18). Project finish has no float left.

Data notes

  • The uploaded files name the project "Phase Two – Part Two" (SUD1-02-011), while the repository folder and the project tracker call it Phase 3 (المرحلة الثالثة).
  • The summary sheet labels cost-based progress as "Plan" and "Actual". This report uses physical progress (man-hour weighted) only: 42.15% planned and 46.41% actual.
  • The Physical-Chart Data sheet plans 44.2% at its October point (06-Oct), more than the 42.15% planned to 26-Oct on the front sheet, and it shows the 26-Oct actual (46.41%) on the 06-Oct point.
  • The front sheet leaves physical progress for electrical, landscape and CCTV works blank; the man-hours in the Progress sheet were used. Its BOQ values for CCTV Zone A and Zone G read 46,056 and 2 SAR instead of 6,513,996 and 2,791,854.
  • The P6 update and the schedule panel of the weekly report now agree (792 completed, 343 in progress, 980 not started), but the front sheet still shows 144 in progress.
  • The weekly report puts the procurement phase baseline at 23-Jan-2027; the approved baseline schedule (uploaded with the previous week) has 21-Nov-2026.
  • The summary page's scope table shows 0 executed for every network, and its totals differ from the hidden Conclusion sheet (for example roads 15,234 m vs 18,252 m). Manholes are labelled "m" in the Major Quantities sheet but are counted in units.
  • Procurement figures disagree: street lighting poles are 590 units and 10% complete in the Procurement sheet but 592 units with 1 delivered in Major Quantities; LV cables are 29,700 m vs 68,400 m. MV cables are "not submitted" in procurement, while the risk register says they have been procured.
  • The manpower sheet repeats the 19-Oct figures. October planned head count is 355 in the monthly table (327 manual, 28 non-manual) but 335 in the head-count panel (300 manual, 35 non-manual).
  • Several cells show #REF! errors (EAC, risk scores, safety score in the status score). The substation risk carries a value of 6,835,460.61 SAR, which is the landscape BOQ value.
  • Several sheets (Major Quantities, Milestones, Physical-Chart Data, Testing, CCO, Risk Register) still carry 19-Oct-2026 as their date, although the report's data date is 26-Oct-2026 and their contents were updated. This-week quantities are the change from the 19-Oct report. The report week is the contract week the report states (42 of 78); whole weeks since handover give 41.
